results.title: Google Gemini Decisions API Cuts 20-Check Cost 16x, but Top Decision Model Passes 63% of Documents
results.description: Simple arithmetic shows why the all-answers rule matters for batches. If 15 answers were independent and each were 97 percent likely to be right, a document would pass about 63 percent of the time, which happens to match Drex Max v1.1's measured pass rate. Real errors correlate: 99 percent per-answer accuracy would predict about 86 percent under independence, yet Claude Haiku 5.5 (Max) measured 92 percent.
